headline: WHAT IS ALL PROMPTS — AND WHY CREATORS ARE PAYING $25/MONTH FOR IT
prompt:
You're grinding. You're trying to figure out how to use AI to actually make money, not just play with it. But every time you open ChatGPT, you're staring at a blank box wondering what to type. Sound familiar?

That's exactly why All Prompts exists.

All Prompts is a constantly updated library of money-making AI prompts built specifically for creators who want to turn AI into income. Not tutorials. Not theory. Actual prompts you can copy, paste into your AI tool, and use to build something worth selling or posting today.

Here's what's inside:

200+ business idea guides. Not vague inspiration — real, specific ideas with the prompts to execute them. Whether you want to launch a digital product, grow a content channel, or build a side hustle, there's a guide for it.

Prompt of the Week. Every week, a fresh prompt lands in the feed. Hand-picked, tested, and built to produce something you can actually use. Content, offers, hooks, art series — the kind of output that moves.

Creator Challenges. Short, structured challenges that push you to actually ship something. The best way to learn AI is to use it under a little pressure. These challenges make it happen.

Content Systems. Not one-off prompts — full systems for creators who want consistency. Instagram content, email sequences, offer copy, lead magnets. Build once, use forever.

The workflow is brutally simple. You open All Prompts. You find a prompt that fits what you're building. You copy it, paste it into ChatGPT or whatever AI tool you use, and you get a result you can sell, post, or ship. No learning curve. No wasted time figuring out what to ask.

This is $25 a month. That's less than a single freelance post. Less than one hour of consulting. Less than the course you bought six months ago and never finished.

If you make one sale from a prompt you found here, it pays for itself. If you post one piece of content that lands, it pays for itself. Most members do both in the first week.

All Prompts isn't for people who want to watch others succeed with AI. It's for the creators who are ready to be the ones doing the work.

Join at https://allpromptshome.ploy.build/
body: This week's deep dive into All Prompts — what it is, who it's for, and why it works.

headline: MONEY MAGNET OFFER
prompt: Create a bold, scroll-stopping product offer post for a digital creator selling a $25/month prompt library. The post must open with a pain point, list 4 specific things the buyer gets, use urgency without being pushy, and close with a one-line CTA. Tone: confident, creator-to-creator. No corporate language.
body: Copy this prompt into ChatGPT and post the result directly to your feed. Converts cold followers into buyers.

headline: VIRAL REEL HOOK GENERATOR
prompt: Write 10 viral Instagram Reel hooks for a creator who sells AI prompts that make money. Each hook must be under 8 words, create instant curiosity, and make the viewer feel like they are missing out on something specific. No generic hooks like 'You won't believe this.' Make every one feel urgent and real.
body: Run this once and you have 10 hooks ready to use this week. Pick your favorite and film.

headline: LIVING CARVINGS — ART SERIES GENERATOR
prompt: Create hyper-realistic fine art portraits of intricately carved creatures actively shaping their own material into a larger surface, debris flying with every strike. Four distinct species, each with a unique material, emotion, and workshop setting. Perfect for collectors who love ornate nature-inspired fine art.
body: Drop this into Midjourney or DALL-E. Four unique collector-grade images from one prompt. Sell the series or use it to grow your art page.
